subtitle_or_header: Generalized Delta Rule for Hidden Layer Weights

labels: (for each Node j at hidden layer)
equations: \frac{\partial E}{\partial w_{ji}} = \frac{\partial E}{\partial Net_{k_1}} \frac{\partial Net_{k_1}}{\partial O_j} + \frac{\partial E}{\partial Net_{k_2}} \frac{\partial Net_{k_2}}{\partial O_j} + ... + \frac{\partial E}{\partial Net_{k_m}} \frac{\partial Net_{k_m}}{\partial O_j} \cdot \frac{\partial O_j}{\partial Net_j} \cdot \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial w_{ji}}

\frac{\partial E}{\partial w_{ji}} = \sum_{k=1}^{m} \frac{\partial E}{\partial Net_k} \frac{\partial Net_k}{\partial O_j} \cdot \frac{\partial O_j}{\partial Net_j} \cdot \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial w_{ji}} = \sum_{k=1}^{m} -\delta_k w_{kj} \cdot O_j(1-O_j) * O_i
\Delta_{ji} = -\eta \frac{\partial E}{\partial W_{ji}} = \sum_{k=1}^{m} \delta_k w_{kj} \cdot O_j(1-O_j) * O_i = \eta \delta_j * O_i
Net_k = \sum_{j} w_{kj} O_j \rightarrow \frac{\partial Net_k}{\partial O_j} = w_{kj}
Net_j = \sum_{i} w_{ji} O_i \rightarrow \frac{\partial Net_j}{\partial w_{ji}} = O_i
